svg.title: Order processing — 20-node renderer example
svg.desc: 20 architecture nodes and 35 directed relationships. Select a component in the interactive view to trace its connections.
svg.text: 20 nodes · 35 relationships · R IDs identify individual arrows

g.title: R01: gateway → validator. Validates request payload [Internal module call]
R02: gateway → auth. Checks order permissions [Internal module call]
R03: gateway → orders. Submits validated order [Internal module call]
R04: orders → pricing. Calculates customer price [Internal module call]
R05: orders → inventory. Reserves available stock [Internal module call]
R06: orders → payments. Requests payment authorization [Internal module call]
R07: orders → repository. Persists order state [Internal module call]
R08: orders → events. Publishes order accepted [Internal module call]
R09: pricing → repository. Reads pricing adjustments [Internal module call]
R10: inventory → repository. Records stock reservations [Internal module call]
R11: payments → provider. Authorizes via @enterprise/payment-authorization-sdk [HTTPS / JSON]
R12: payments → provider. Captures authorized payment [HTTPS / JSON]
R13: payments → orders. Returns authorization outcome [Internal module call]
R14: repository → database. Reads and writes order records [SQL / TCP]
R15: events → worker. Delivers fulfilment command [Asynchronous event]
R16: worker → inventory. Commits stock reservation [Internal module call]
R17: worker → repository. Updates delivery status [Internal module call]
R18: worker → events. Publishes delivery completed [Asynchronous event]
R19: worker → worker. Retries with exponential backoff [Internal module call]
R20: auth → repository. Verifies order ownership [Internal module call]
R21: gateway → catalog. Looks up orderable products [Internal module call]
R22: orders → customers. Loads customer preferences [Internal module call]
R23: orders → fraud. Requests payment risk decision [Internal module call]
R24: fraud → customers. Checks customer history [Internal module call]
R25: fraud → payments. Checks authorization signals [Internal module call]
R26: catalog → products. Reads product definitions [SQL / TCP]
R27: pricing → catalog. Loads current product prices [Internal module call]
R28: inventory → products. Reads stock keeping units [SQL / TCP]
R29: events → notifications. Queues order confirmation [Asynchronous event]
R30: notifications → templates. Renders localized confirmation [Internal module call]
R31: templates → customers. Loads customer language [Internal module call]
R32: notifications → email. Sends confirmation email [HTTPS / JSON]
R33: orders → audit. Records order transitions [Internal module call]
R34: payments → audit. Records payment outcome [Internal module call]
R35: audit → database. Appends immutable audit record [SQL / TCP]

g.title: Payment integration adapter — TypeScript / Node.js

Notification worker — TypeScript / Node.js

g.title: Email delivery provider — HTTPS / JSON
